character: The closest of Victoria's major resorts to Melbourne (about three hours by road), with a compact on-mountain village beneath the summit and runs spread around it. Mt Buller is on the Ikon Pass.
learning: Reference note: the village has a ski and snowboard school and beginner areas; confirm 2027 lesson products and prices.

source.note: Winter 2026: opened Fri 5 Jun 2026, one day ahead of the scheduled opening weekend (search summary; result attribution uncertain). Closed Sun 27 Sep 2026 (shared research notes, https://www.onthesnow.com/australia/projected-closing).

season.typicalText: The season traditionally starts on the King's Birthday long weekend in early June (Buller opened a day early on 5 Jun 2026); the 2026 season ended on 27 Sep.
season.notes: Southern Hemisphere: Piste season id 2026-27 is the June–October 2027 winter (the one the 2026-27 Ikon and Epic passes cover); 2025-26 is the 2026 winter and 2024-25 the 2025 winter. No 2027 opening or closing date was found as of 2026-09-30. Australian resorts traditionally open on the King's Birthday long weekend — in 2027 that is Sat 12 – Mon 14 June (calendar inference, not an announcement). Victorian alpine resorts charge a resort entry fee (reference). Official site (2026-10-03): ski school "Closed for Winter 2026. See you in 2027!"; 2027 Season Membership early-bird sale ends 31 October; no 2027 dates announced on saved pages.
